|lore=Defender sporting blaster, made by Drearian Defense Conglomerate. Intended for personal defense or small-game hunting. Short range. Low power. Carries energy for 50 shots.
|game_text=Deploy on Leia or your non-droid Undercover spy. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > defense value. If Undercover, may "break cover" to fire during opponent's move phase.

|notes=The 2006 slip explicitly ties the break-cover option to being on your Undercover spy. The [[Leia's Sporting Blaster (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Leia's Sporting Blaster (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 11. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Leia's Sporting Blaster]].
* 2006 publication: [[Leia's Sporting Blaster (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
